description: 국토교통부_도시철도 노선 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 도시 철도 노선 정보는 철도 이용자와 운영자의 효율성을 높이는 데 필수적인 핵심 데이터입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 도시철도노선정보, 철도이용자, 철도운영자, 지하철노선현황, 도시철도운행정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
